public.title: Design Hit Counter
public.description: Process operations ["hit",timestamp] and ["getHits",timestamp], returning null for hit and the count for getHits. Timestamps are nondecreasing positive integer seconds. At time t count hits strictly after t-300 and through t; repeated hit calls count separately. At most 1000 operations, timestamps at most 1000000.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: A moving head drops timestamps outside the half-open trailing window. Each hit is inserted and discarded once, giving O(operations) total time.
